description: Na₃Mg₄CrSi₈(O₁₁F)₂ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.53 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.53 Å. There are four inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form MgO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CrO₆ octahedra, and edges with five MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.10 Å. Both Mg-F bond lengths are 2.06 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form MgO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CrO₆ octahedra, and edges with four MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.13 Å. There is one shorter (2.08 Å) and one longer (2.09 Å) Mg-F bond length. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.24 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form MgO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CrO₆ octahedra, and edges with four MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.13 Å. There is one shorter (2.08 Å) and one longer (2.09 Å) Mg-F bond length. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.15 Å. There are eight inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CrO₆ octahedra, corners with two MgO₄F₂ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-57°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CrO₆ octahedra, corners with two MgO₄F₂ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-56°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.68 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three MgO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-62°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-61°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-57°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å.
